lee: quick sync for TONIGHT's 23:00 UTC change window. Cross-service set: api-service -> v2.4.2-pin, runtime -> v3.0.0-rc3 (kv eviction + perf), router -> header-swap v5.2-canary, console -> commit def456. Need deploy order, canary gates, and explicit rollback owners.
maria: ran extended staging smoke: api v2.4.2 passes contract tests, console def456 UI flows ok. runtime-rc3 passed perf harness but theres a small mem trend. https://staging.redwood/ci/10222 :white_check_mark:
sam: noted mem trend. propose runtime fallback to v2.9.9 if RSS increases >20% sustained over 10m OR >2 OOMs across workers. Also verifying KV cache keyspace unchanged for api v2.4.2.
kiran: i'll be oncall for this window. suggested rollback triggers: service-error-rate >0.4% for 2 consecutive 5m bins OR p99 latency >40% above baseline OR kv-cache-miss rate >0.2% sustained. On trigger we do immediate traffic-hold and staged rollback (runtime first, router next, api last). :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: window scheduled 2026-03-24 23:00-23:45 UTC. Preflight at T-60m. Canary plan: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with pauses after each step. Rollback TTL 45m. Services queued: api-service, runtime, router, console.
maria: KV compatibility validated on staging: 20k request run, zero format errors. Runtime team confirmed no hotfix required for prefix keys.
sam: approved rollback commands (ops vetted):
```
ri deploy rollback --service runtime --to-tag v2.9.9
ri deploy rollback --service router --to-tag stable-20260324
ri deploy rollback --service api-service --to-tag v2.4.1
```
lee: suggested order: 1) pin api-service v2.4.2 2) deploy runtime rc3 3) router header-swap canary 4) console def456. Reason: pin API contract first so runtime can rely on stable behavior during canary.
kiran: +1. add explicit manual hold after 20% canary for router; approver: lee. Who approves runtime at 20%? sam?
sam: i'll take runtime approve/watch. i'll give a thumbs up if mem/restarts stable after 10m. If not, i'll trigger rollback command.
deploy-bot: preflight OK: infra capacity OK (reserve 25% headroom), config diff OK, schema checks OK. Canary schedule created and will post updates to #eng-sre.
lee: i'll draft a two-line release note and post to #release-notes at T-30. Include exact rollback commands and SLO triggers.
kiran: note: console enables a settings toggle for header preview. keep it off until router is at 60% to avoid inconsistent UX.
sam: enabling quick diagnostics: endpoint to fetch runtime heap + traces: `/ops/debug/heapdump` and `/ops/debug/kv-stats` (pre-auth). Oncall can call these.
lee: good. final: anyone blocking?
maria: no blockers from staging.
kiran: i'll be available. deploying with manual hold points and clear rollback owners. :thumbsup:
lee: thanks all. ping here for any alerts; @deploy-bot will broadcast timeline on start. :rocket:
